# Hand-made adventure chart
start: Wake in cell | gives: spoon
dig: Dig tunnel | needs: spoon | gives: yard_access, dirt
guard: Distract guard | needs: yard_access | gives: keys
shed: Open shed | needs: yard_access | gives: rope
wall: Climb wall | needs: rope, keys | gives: freedom
pot: Hide dirt in pots | needs: dirt | gives: no_alarm
gate: Leave by gate | needs: freedom, no_alarm
